It directly calls `self.check_stmt`, `self.check_expr_with_expectation`, `self.get_expr_coercion_span`, `self.cause`, `self.suggest_block_to_brackets`, `self.get_parent_fn_decl`, `self.parent_item_span`, `self.misc`, `self.only_has_type`, `self.consider_removing_semicolon`, and `self.consider_returning_binding`.

Checks whether removing a trailing semicolon from the block could satisfy the expected type, and if so emits either a boxing-aware verbose suggestion or a simple semicolon-removal suggestion. Finds the span of the enclosing function or impl method body block for a given HIR node, returning `None` when the parent item is not a function-like block.
Looks up the parent item of a block and extracts its function declaration and identifier when the parent is function-like. It directly calls `self.get_node_fn_decl`.

Chooses a more precise span for expression coercion diagnostics by preferring the active tail of `if`/`match`/block expressions when type checking has already established a non-`!` type, and otherwise falling back to the expression span.

When a local or pattern type resolves to an error type, overwrites the recorded types for both HIR nodes and updates the locals table so later checks do not cascade from stale types. It directly calls `self.write_ty`.

Completes type resolution for a struct-like path across resolved, type-relative, and lang-item forms, producing both the resolution and the resulting type while updating stored resolution info for type-relative paths. It directly calls `self.to_ty`, `AstConv::res_to_ty`, `AstConv::associated_path_to_ty`, `self.write_resolution`, and `self.resolve_lang_item_path`.

Refines fulfillment-error spans so diagnostics point at the specific call argument responsible for a trait obligation failure instead of the whole call, while avoiding desugared spans and tracing derived obligations back to their top-level cause. It uses the local helper `unpeel_to_top` to recover the originating obligation cause.
Local helper that walks through nested derived-obligation cause codes and returns the highest-level originating cause code.

Refines fulfillment-error spans for function calls with explicit generic arguments by moving the blame from the full call to the particular type argument whose resolved type matches the failing trait predicate. It directly calls `self.resolve_vars_if_possible`.

Checks whether a multi-argument call could instead match a single tuple parameter by resolving the sole expected input type, requiring it to be a tuple, type-checking each provided argument, and verifying pairwise equality against the tuple elements. If every element matches, it returns a tuple-wrapping suggestion shape for diagnostics; otherwise it returns `None`. It does not call any other method from the provided Methods List.
method_docs.compiler/rustc_typeck/src/check/autodere: Constructs an `Autoderef` iterator for `base_ty` in the current function context using the same `span` for both lookup and overloaded-deref reporting. Calls `Autoderef::new`.

Checks whether `base_ty` can be dereferenced through an overloaded trait-based place operation and returns the resolved `MethodCallee` plus inference obligations when successful. Calls `try_overloaded_place_op` with `PlaceOp::Deref`.
Builds the autoderef adjustment list and immediately registers any inference obligations produced during that computation. Calls `adjust_steps_as_infer_ok`, then `register_infer_ok_obligations`.

Converts each autoderef step into an `Adjustment`, pairing every source type with its next target type and collecting trait obligations along the way. method_docs.compiler/rustc_trait_selection/src/autod: Advances the autoderef iterator by yielding the initial type first, then stopping on recursion-limit overflow, inference variables, or error types, otherwise trying builtin deref before overloaded deref, recording the chosen step, and returning the new type with its depth. It calls `report_autoderef_recursion_limit_error` when the recursion limit is exceeded, `overloaded_deref_ty` to attempt trait-based deref when builtin deref does not apply, and `step_count` to report the current deref depth.
Constructs a fresh `Autoderef` search state from the base type, resolving inference variables up front and initializing empty steps and obligations with diagnostics enabled.

Attempts trait-based deref by building a `<T as Deref>` obligation, quickly rejecting impossible cases, normalizing the `Deref::Target` projection in a fulfillment context, collecting any resulting obligations, and returning the resolved target type on success.
Returns the current autoderef type, optionally resolving any remaining inference variables before producing it.
Returns the number of deref steps recorded so far.
Consumes the iterator state and returns the accumulated trait obligations produced during overloaded deref steps.
Exposes the recorded deref history as the sequence of resulting types and whether each step was builtin or overloaded.
Returns the source span associated with this autoderef search.
Returns the span used when attributing overloaded-deref obligations or diagnostics.
Reports whether iteration previously stopped because the autoderef recursion limit was hit.
Enables traversal through raw-pointer deref steps and returns the updated `Autoderef` builder state.
Disables recursion-limit diagnostics for this autoderef search and returns the updated `Autoderef` builder state.
Emits the user-facing autoderef recursion-limit diagnostic once per span/message combination, including a label and help text suggesting a higher recursion limit.
method_docs.compiler/rustc_infer/src/infer/opaque_ty: Handles relating an opaque type to another type during inference: it ignores error types, determines which side is the opaque, checks whether the opaque is being defined in the current context, diagnoses invalid opaque-to-opaque hidden-type cases, and then equates or records the hidden type as appropriate. It calls `opaque_type_origin` when defining-use checks are required, `opaque_ty_origin_unchecked` otherwise, and `register_hidden_type` to store the inferred hidden type before using the inference relation machinery to equate types.

Builds lifetime membership constraints for an inferred opaque hidden type so every region appearing in the concrete type is restricted to the opaque type's allowed lifetime arguments or `'static`. It calls `opaque_ty_origin_unchecked` to determine how many generics belong to the opaque itself, resolves inference variables in the concrete type, and then visits the type to emit member constraints.

Returns the origin of a local opaque type only if that opaque may be defined from the current defining-use anchor, distinguishing async/fn-return opaques from type-alias opaques. It uses HIR lookup plus `may_define_opaque_type` to decide whether a type-alias opaque is in scope for definition.

Fetches the HIR-declared origin of a local opaque type without checking whether the current context is allowed to define it. It performs only local-ID conversion and item-kind inspection, and does not call other methods from the provided Methods List.
Visits the contents of a binder without special casing it, delegating traversal to `t.super_visit_with(self)` and then continuing.
Processes each region seen by the visitor, ignoring late-bound regions and invoking the visitor callback `self.op` for all other regions before continuing.

Traverses only types that contain free regions and skips enclosing-item lifetime parameters for closures and generators. For closures it calls `substs.as_closure().tupled_upvars_ty().visit_with(self)` and `substs.as_closure().sig_as_fn_ptr_ty().visit_with(self)`; for generators it calls `substs.as_generator().tupled_upvars_ty().visit_with(self)`, `return_ty().visit_with(self)`, `yield_ty().visit_with(self)`, and `resume_ty().visit_with(self)`; otherwise it falls back to `ty.super_visit_with(self)`.
Returns whether this `UseKind` represents a defining use, yielding true for `DefiningUse` and false for `OpaqueUse`.

Registers or updates the inferred hidden type for an opaque definition, equates it with any previously registered hidden type, and then instantiates the opaque item's explicit bounds against the hidden type while introducing inference variables for projections and substituting self-references to the same opaque. It does not call other methods from the provided Methods List.
Checks whether a named opaque type may be defined from the given local item by walking up the HIR parent chain from the item to see whether it reaches the opaque type’s defining scope.

Builds a `PredicateObligation` for an opaque-type relation, ordering `a` and `b` according to `a_is_expected` and then wrapping `ty::PredicateKind::OpaqueType(a, b)` in a dummy binder and interned predicate. It does not call any other method from the provided Methods List.

Returns the current inferred opaque-type map by borrowing the inference context’s inner state and delegating to the opaque-type storage accessor. It does not call any other method from the provided Methods List.
method_docs.compiler/rustc_trait_selection/src/opaqu: Trait method declaration for inferring an opaque type's hidden definition type from an instantiated use-site hidden type; implemented by the `InferCtxt` method of the same name.

Infers the hidden definition type for an opaque type by reverse-mapping instantiated substitutions back into the opaque type's generic parameter space, rejecting tainted/error states early, folding the hidden type through `ReverseMapper::new`, and validating the defining use with `check_opaque_type_parameter_valid`. For `OpaqueTyOrigin::TyAlias`, it additionally re-checks well-formedness and bound satisfaction in a fresh inference context, registers the hidden type and obligations, and reports mismatches or fulfillment errors before returning the rebuilt opaque type.
Constructs a `ReverseMapper` initialized with the type context, opaque type id, reverse substitution map, hidden type, and diagnostic span.
Folds a generic argument with the reverse mapper while temporarily enabling missing-region fallback to the empty root region; this method calls `fold_with`.
Folds a generic argument with normal reverse-mapping behavior, without permitting missing regions; this method calls `fold_with`.
Returns the `TyCtxt` carried by the reverse mapper.

Reverse-maps regions from the instantiated hidden type back to the opaque definition, leaving late-bound/static/erased regions unchanged, translating mapped early-bound/free regions through the substitution map, and emitting diagnostics for unexpected or non-defining hidden lifetimes. This method calls `tcx` to inspect generics and obtain fallback lifetime values.

Reverse-maps types inside the hidden type, with special handling for closures and generators so parent generic arguments may map missing regions to `'empty`, remaps type parameters through the reverse substitution map, reports unmapped captured type parameters as invalid defining uses, and otherwise recursively folds substructure. This method calls `fold_kind_mapping_missing_regions_to_empty` and `fold_kind_normally` for closure/generator substs, and falls back to `super_fold_with` for other types.

Reverse-maps const generic parameters appearing in the hidden type back to the opaque type's parameter space, returning mapped const params when found and otherwise emitting an error and producing a const error value for unmapped defining-scope consts.

Exposes the current expected/found polarity flag used by the subtype relation. It does not call any other listed methods.
Temporarily replaces the active relation cause, executes a closure under that cause, and restores the previous cause afterward. It does not call any other listed methods.

Dispatches subtype comparison according to variance: invariant uses equality, covariant preserves direction, bivariant accepts `a`, and contravariant swaps the operands and expectedness. It explicitly calls `with_expected_switched` for contravariant cases.

Performs subtype checking for types by first resolving inference variables, then handling unresolved type variables via deferred subtype obligations or instantiation, propagating error types, structurally relating matching opaque aliases, defining local opaques when enabled, and otherwise delegating to the general type combiner. It explicitly calls `tcx` when building the deferred subtype obligation.

Enforces region subtyping by creating a `Subtype` origin from the current trace and recording the corresponding subregion constraint, returning the left region. It explicitly calls `tag` for debug logging.
Delegates const subtyping to the inference context's shared const-combine logic. It does not call any other listed methods.
Handles higher-ranked subtyping for binders by delegating to the shared `higher_ranked_sub` helper and then returning the left binder. It does not call any other listed methods.
Registers a const-equality obligation using the current expected/found polarity. It does not call any other listed methods.

Compares two impl headers by matching their kind and delegating to `eq` on the relevant components: it calls `eq` for trait refs when both headers are trait impls, or `eq` for self types when both are inherent impls; mismatched impl kinds trigger a bug.
Builds a traced comparison for diagnostics and then performs a subtyping check between `a` and `b`. It explicitly calls `trace_exp`, and then calls `sub` on the resulting traced adapter.

Performs an equality relation under the stored cause and parameter environment by calling `At::trace` and then `Trace::eq`.
Dispatches a relation based on variance: it calls `At::sub` for covariant, `At::eq` for invariant, and `At::sup` for contravariant cases, while rejecting bivariant input with a panic.
Computes the least upper bound under the stored cause and parameter environment by calling `At::trace` and then `Trace::lub`.
Computes the greatest lower bound under the stored cause and parameter environment by calling `At::trace` and then `Trace::glb`.
Builds a `Trace` wrapper for a comparison by calling `ToTrace::to_trace` to create the underlying `TypeTrace`, then packaging it together with this `At` context.
Constructs a `Trace` wrapper for a comparison by creating a `TypeTrace` from the cause, expectation direction, and operands. It explicitly calls `to_trace` to build the trace payload.

Executes a traced subtype comparison by creating combine fields from the inference context, then invoking the relation engine's `sub` and `relate` operations, and finally mapping the result into `InferOk` with accumulated obligations; it does not call any other method from the Methods List.

Executes a traced equality comparison by creating combine fields, then invoking `equate(StructurallyRelateAliases::No)` and `relate`, and mapping the result into `InferOk`; it does not call any other method from the Methods List.

Executes a traced least-upper-bound computation by creating combine fields, then invoking the relation engine's `lub` and `relate` operations, and mapping the resulting merged value plus obligations into `InferOk`; it does not call any other method from the Methods List.

Executes a traced greatest-lower-bound computation by creating combine fields, then invoking the relation engine's `glb` and `relate` operations, and mapping the resulting merged value plus obligations into `InferOk`; it does not call any other method from the Methods List.

Constructs a `TypeTrace` for two terms by cloning the cause and packaging the pair as `Terms(ExpectedFound<Term>)`; it does not call any other method from the Methods List.

Constructs and returns an `At` adapter bound to this inference context, the given `ObligationCause`, and `ParamEnv`, with opaque type definition enabled. It does not call any other method from the Methods List.
Builds a `TypeTrace` for comparing two consts by cloning the obligation cause and storing the pair as `ExpectedFound` terms. It does not call any other method from the Methods List.

Finalizes the accumulated data for one HIR owner into arena-allocated `OwnerInfo`. Maps an AST `NodeId` to a HIR id for the current owner, reusing an existing mapping or allocating a new local id. Converts a resolver `Res<NodeId>` into a HIR `Res` by calling `apply_id` to rewrite each referenced node id through the current `node_id_to_local_id` mapping, using `get` and `copied` for lookup. If rewriting fails for an enclosing-owner local, it returns `Res::Err` via `unwrap_or`.
Obtains the full resolver result for a node id by calling `self.resolver.get_partial_res(id)` and converting it with `map_or(..., |pr| pr.expect_full_res())`, defaulting to `Res::Err` if missing.
Extracts the fully resolved imported items for a `use` item from the resolver. It calls `impl ResolverAstLoweringExt for ResolverAstLowering::get_import_res`.
Returns the session diagnostic handler used by lowering for error reporting. It does not call other methods in the Methods List.
Marks a span as desugared with the given reason and optional unstable allowances using the stable hashing context and current edition. It calls `with_stable_hashing_context` and `mark_with_reason`.
Temporarily switches `self.anonymous_lifetime_mode` for the duration of a closure, runs the closure, then restores the previous mode. It directly calls the passed closure `op`.
Adjusts a span for HIR lowering, attaching the current owner as the parent only when incremental compilation is enabled; otherwise returns the span unchanged.
Rebuilds an identifier with its span lowered for HIR. This method explicitly calls `lower_span`.

Temporarily enables anonymous-lifetime collection for a given parent def, records the starting length of `lifetimes_to_define`, runs a closure, then returns only the newly collected lifetime defs and restores the previous collection state. It directly calls the passed closure `f`.
Temporarily extends `in_scope_lifetimes` with lifetime parameters from the given generic params, runs a closure, and then restores the previous scope length. It directly calls the passed closure `f`.

Lowers generics while collecting anonymous in-band lifetime defs and additional impl-trait defs, then appends synthesized lifetime parameters and returns the final HIR generics together with the closure result. Executes a closure in a fresh lowering scope by temporarily replacing current item, loop-condition, catch, and loop scope state, then restoring all previous values afterward.
Lowers and stores attributes for a HIR node, returning `None` for an empty attribute list. This method explicitly calls `lower_attr` for each attribute.
Lowers a single AST attribute by preserving its path/data structure, stripping tokens, lowering its arguments, and lowering its span. It calls `lower_attr_args` and `lower_span`.
Aliases already-lowered attributes from one HIR local id to another within the same owner when the target has stored attributes.

Lowers macro-argument token structures, preserving delimited arguments via token-stream lowering and handling key-value attributes by extracting a single lowered token. It explicitly calls `lower_token_stream` and the nested helper `unwrap_single_token` from the Methods List.

Recursively extracts one token from a token stream for key-value attribute lowering, reporting delayed bugs for malformed multi-token or unexpectedly delimited inputs and yielding a dummy token when empty. It explicitly calls `unwrap_single_token` recursively from the Methods List.

Flattens and lowers a token stream using the parse session, nonterminal-to-tokenstream mapping, and the selected token-synthesis policy. It does not call any other methods from the provided Methods List.

Lowers an associated type constraint, including its generic arguments, equality/const/type terms, and bound forms, while diagnosing invalid parenthesized or return-type-notation syntax. Lowers a generic argument as a lifetime, type, inferred arg, or const arg, including the path-type-to-const disambiguation path used for trivial const arguments. Lowers an AST type and arena-allocates the resulting HIR type node. This method explicitly calls `lower_ty_direct`.

Lowers a path type, opportunistically converting a bare resolved trait path into a trait object when needed for fresh anonymous lifetimes; otherwise lowers it as a normal qpath type. Constructs a HIR type node with a fresh `HirId` and lowered span. It calls `next_id` and `lower_span`.
Constructs a tuple HIR type from pre-lowered element types. This method explicitly calls `ty`.

Performs the main AST-to-HIR lowering for type syntax, handling anonymous ADTs, pointers/references, functions, tuples, paths, and other type forms while creating nested owners when required. This method explicitly calls `local_def_id`, `with_hir_id_owner`, `lower_field_def`, `lower_span`, `lower_ty`, `lower_mt`, `get_lifetime_res`, `next_node_id`, `lower_lifetime`, `lower_lifetime_binder`, `lower_safety`, `lower_extern`, `lower_fn_decl`, and `lower_fn_params_to_names`.

Lowers an `impl Trait` opaque type by marking its desugared span, determining which lifetimes must be captured or duplicated based on origin and precise captures, and delegating final opaque construction. Builds an HIR owner node for a synthesized opaque type item by wrapping the provided opaque type in `hir::Item` metadata and allocating it in the arena. It does not call any other methods from the provided Methods List.

Extracts lowered parameter names from a function declaration, using the lowered identifier for simple identifier patterns and an empty placeholder ident otherwise. It calls `lower_ident` and `lower_span`.

Lowers a function signature by dropping the AST varargs sentinel, lowering each input type under the appropriate `impl Trait` policy, and lowering the return type either normally or through coroutine-specific opaque-return handling. It calls `lower_ty_direct`, `local_def_id`, `lower_coroutine_fn_ret_ty`, `lower_ty`, and `lower_span`.

Lowers an `async fn` return type into the desugared opaque `impl Future` HIR return, collecting captured extra lifetimes, building the async opaque type, and wrapping it as `FnRetTy::Return`. It calls `impl ResolverAstLoweringExt for ResolverAstLowering::take_extra_lifetime_params` and `impl<'a, 'hir> LoweringContext<'a, 'hir>::lower_async_fn_output_type_to_future_bound`.

Builds the `Future<Output = T>` bound used in async-fn desugaring by lowering the explicit return type or synthesizing `()` for default returns, then packaging it as a `Future` lang-item trait bound. It does not call other methods in the Methods List.

Lowers a single generic bound into HIR, converting trait bounds and outlives bounds through the appropriate lowerers. It calls `lower_poly_trait_ref`, `lower_trait_bound_modifiers`, and `lower_lifetime`.

Resolves a lifetime through `get_lifetime_res`, defaulting to `LifetimeRes::Error` on failure, then calls `new_named_lifetime_with_res` to produce the lowered HIR lifetime.
Returns an iterator that lowers each generic parameter by mapping the input slice and calling `lower_generic_param` for every element.
Lowers a slice of generic parameters into arena-allocated HIR output by calling `lower_generic_params_mut` and collecting the iterator with `alloc_from_iter`.

Lowers one generic parameter by calling `lower_generic_param_kind` to compute its HIR name and kind, then assigns ids/spans/attributes using `lower_node_id`, `lower_attrs`, `local_def_id`, and `lower_span`.
Lowers an AST trait reference by calling `lower_qpath`, requiring the result to be a resolved trait path, and then creating the HIR trait ref with `lower_node_id` for the reference id.
Lowers a poly trait reference by calling `lower_lifetime_binder` for bound generic params, `lower_trait_ref` for the trait itself, and `lower_span` for the resulting HIR span.
Lowers a mutable type by calling `lower_ty` on the inner type and preserving the mutability flag.
Lowers a slice of generic bounds into arena-allocated HIR bounds by calling `lower_param_bounds_mut` and collecting with `alloc_from_iter`.
Returns an iterator that lowers each generic bound by mapping the slice and calling `lower_param_bound` on each element.
